name: BanglaXpress - E-Commerce Store
description: A modern Bangladeshi e-commerce platform with Shopify-style admin dashboard, direct dropshipping import from AliExpress, 1688, Alibaba, CJ Dropshipping, and Taobao, vendor-wise payment methods, 1-click fast express checkout, no-code visual homepage theme customizer, bKash & Nagad payments, and inventory management.
